feed_summary: AI is beginning to take over much of the work that has traditionally defined the security analyst's job. Investigating alerts, collecting evidence, correlating activity across tools, and executing response actions are becoming tasks that AI systems can perform on their own. title: The Rise of the Threat Operator: How AI Will Redefine Security Operations and Careers
